Methods
Oxford Nanopore reads were trimmed with Porechop. The reads were processed
with dnaPipeTE, which used Trinity to assemble repeat sequences. RepeatMasker
annotated the repeat library, and a custom Perl script combined the tables.
PiRATE combined evidence from RepeatModeler and dipSPAdes 3.12.0. Bowtie2 and
seqkit processed reads, parseRM.pl summarized repeats, and LTRpred plus
Trinotate annotated sequences before CD-HIT-est clustering.
